boundaries: F-16, SR-71 and X-15 use conventional compressible aerodynamic models with reduced simulation coefficients; they are not manufacturer data and the aircraft are not performance-certified.
EIDOLON, MANTA, SKYRMION and Syntax Jacob use explicitly separated experimental models that receive exactly zero aerodynamic load; the isolation is re-checked on every integration step.
E47 kernel constants are consumed from the generated canonical lock; the browser cannot restate them independently of src/e47.
E47 capture is a thrust multiplier inside a simulation, not a probability and not a physical threshold; the Stargate physical gate remains shut.
Atmosphere, gravity and geodesy follow published standards (US Standard Atmosphere 1976, WGS84 normal gravity); terrain elevation accuracy is bounded by the DEM tile source in use.
